stem: The numbers of customers arriving at service desks $A$ and $B$ during a 10-minute period have the independent distributions $\text{Po}(1.8)$ and $\text{Po}(2.1)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that during a randomly chosen 15-minute period more than 2 customers will arrive at desk $A$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that during a randomly chosen 5-minute period the total number of customers arriving at both desks is less than 4.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An inspector waits at desk $B$. She wants to wait long enough to be 90% certain of seeing at least one customer arrive at the desk.

Find the minimum time for which she should wait, giving your answer correct to the nearest minute.
